Q1: Which of the audit's recommendations should this issue implement in the shared review workflow (`review_autofix.yml`, reused by consumer repos)?
Choices:
A) Only cancel stale auto-merge. On every `pull_request.synchronize`, the gate job turns off any enabled auto-merge on the PR, failing closed and logging the outcome. The review of the new head turns it back on if that head passes.
B) A, plus a commit status tied to the head SHA (fixed context name, e.g. `ai-review/head-gate`). It is set to pending when the head changes and to success only after review and the single-issue security pass finish for that exact SHA. Repos make it a required check in their own branch protection; the docs explain how, and nothing changes branch protection automatically. This also covers pushes made with `GITHUB_TOKEN`, which fire no synchronize event. (RECOMMENDED)
C) B, plus code that adds the new status to branch protection through the API. This needs an admin-scoped token and changes repo settings in consumer repos without review.
